summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its 30 October 2026 London announcement of open-market purchases under an existing buyback programme executed via UBS AG, London Branch under instructions dated 16 February 2026. Across three venues it bought 2,940,059 (LSE), 919,719 (CHIX) and 2,982,263 (BATE) ordinary shares, totaling roughly 6.8 million, at 576.20–626.00 GBp, volume-weighted averages near 585.7–586.9 GBp. Repurchased shares will be cancelled; treasury holds 177,875,932 and 7,911,207,892 shares remain in issue. Watch execution pace, cancellation-driven share-count shrinkage and buyback completion versus capital-return guidance.
